decision: IX.53 brief: the 18 arm.bignum_{add,sub,neg}_<family> functional-correctness tasks were run as R4 development data and disclosed as such in research/receipts/r4-reference-route.md §0 and §3 (16/18 baseline, recorded in research/receipts/r4-verdicts.csv). The R2 held-out set is already spent, so these ids are spent development data, not a held-out target; re-answering them is a repair of a development result. This manifest is the sole allow-list for --spent, and proof text for every listed id stays unreadable.
